title: Shopify vs WooCommerce for Indian Businesses
verdict: Choose Shopify if you want speed and reliability with minimal technical upkeep. Choose WooCommerce if you already run WordPress, want full control of your data and code, and have someone to maintain it.
seoTitle: Shopify vs WooCommerce for Indian Stores (2026)
seoDescription: Shopify or WooCommerce for an Indian online store: costs, payments, GST invoices, COD, Tally integration, hosting and control. A practical comparison.
summary: Shopify is a hosted platform: quick to launch, reliable, and paid monthly with app subscriptions on top. WooCommerce is a free WordPress plugin you host yourself: more control and lower platform fees, but you own hosting, security and updates. For most Indian D2C brands without a developer, Shopify is simpler; WooCommerce suits teams already on WordPress or needing deep customisation.

dataPoints.label: Hosting
dataPoints.value: Shopify: included and managed. WooCommerce: your own hosting, from shared plans to cloud servers

dataPoints.label: Running costs
dataPoints.value: Shopify: monthly plan plus paid apps. WooCommerce: hosting, premium plugins and maintenance time

dataPoints.label: Indian payments
dataPoints.value: Both support Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU and UPI through gateway apps or plugins

dataPoints.label: GST invoices
dataPoints.value: Both need an app or plugin for GST-compliant invoices with HSN and GSTIN

dataPoints.label: Tally integration
dataPoints.value: Both possible via connectors or custom integration using their APIs

dataPoints.label: Customisation
dataPoints.value: Shopify: themes, apps and Liquid; deep changes limited. WooCommerce: full PHP code access

body:
## Where each wins

| Need | Better fit |
| --- | --- |
| Launch in two weeks without a developer | Shopify |
| Already have a WordPress content site | WooCommerce |
| Heavy traffic spikes during sales | Shopify |
| Unusual checkout or pricing logic | WooCommerce, or custom |
| Lowest monthly platform fees | WooCommerce |

## Costs that surprise people

On Shopify, app subscriptions for reviews, GST invoices, WhatsApp and subscriptions add up. On WooCommerce, the surprise is maintenance: plugin conflicts, security updates and hosting performance.

See our cost guide for [e-commerce websites](/cost/ecommerce-website) and the [Tally and Shopify integration](/integrations/tally-shopify).

Prices and plan features change often; check the vendors' current Indian pricing before deciding.

faqs.q: Can I move from WooCommerce to Shopify later?
faqs.a: Yes. Products, customers and orders can be migrated; plan URL redirects to keep search rankings.
Both can rank well. Page speed, content and structure matter more than the platform.
